records.name: Materials Futures
records.publisher: IOP Publishing in collaboration with Dongguan Institute of Materials Science and Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
records.scope_notes: Materials theory and computational materials design, quantum, atomistic, microstructure and continuum simulation, and property prediction.

route.conditions: Sponsor currently covers article publication charges; reviews and perspectives normally invited. Video abstract invited and future perspectives section required; independent audit should check other mandatory costs.

fee_evidence.note: Publisher identifies sponsored publication without author charges.
IOP submission guidance says its journals do not charge to submit; confirm applicability and ancillary charges independently.

notes: Four additional venues support theoretical, simulation, or existing-data studies; no new physical laboratory work is assumed.

IOP author generative AI policy explicitly permits research, code and text generation with human validation and disclosure; AI policy role must independently verify journal applicability and restrictions: https://publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org/questions/generative-ai-tools/
Materials Futures sponsors APCs currently; submission and ancillary-cost applicability requires independent audit.

Rejected Journal of Physics: Materials and Journal of Physics: Complexity: both disclose mandatory article publication charges absent a conditional agreement or waiver: https://publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org/journals/journal-of-physics-materials/about-journal-physics-materials/ and https://publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org/journals/journal-of-physics-complexity/about-journal-physics-complexity/
